# Components

## Application Security Management (IAST)

* :sparkles: Add IAST code injection detection for BeanShell (#12113 - @claponcet)

## Application Security Management (WAF)

* :sparkles: Add API Security schema extraction and missing-route metrics (#12300 - @jandro996)
* :bug: Bound unresolved-artifact retry loop in ScaReachabilityTransformer (#12245 - @jandro996)
* :sparkles: Add HTTP span tags to the AWS Lambda invocation span (#12226 - @claponcet)
* :sparkles: Bump libsqreen (libddwaf-java) to 17.5.0 for libddwaf 2.0.1 (#12118 - @jandro996)

## Configuration

* :bug: Support OpenTelemetry deployment environment names (#12324 - @tylfin)

## Continuous Integration Visibility

* :bug: Avoid empty headless test sessions (#12146 - @daniel-mohedano)

## Crash Tracking

* :bug: Add `is_crash` tag to crash report (#12156 - @gyuheon0h)

## Data Streams Monitoring

* :sparkles: Capture Kafka consumer group membership on join (#11989 - @piochelepiotr)

## Dynamic Instrumentation

* :bug: Disable Exception Replay for JDK < 11 (#12411 - @jpbempel)
* :sparkles::broom: Add telemetry metrics for dropped/skipped events (#12319 - @jpbempel)
* :broom: Add additional collection classes as unsafe (#12280 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Make snapshot list for ThrowableState concurrent (#12270 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Fix redaction marker for log template (#12269 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Fix memory leak with FastThrow optimization (#12254 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Add null checks for calls to getAllLoadedClasses (#12236 - @jpbempel)
* :bug: Fix error spam from filtered out log probes (#12207 - @tylfin)
* :bug: Close jar entry streams during Symbol Database scan (#12143 - @tylfin)

## ML Observability (LLMObs)

* :bug: Fix OpenAI Java 4.54 compatibility (#12340 - @AlexeyKuznetsov-DD)
* :sparkles: Add annotateAgentManifest manual API to LLMObs SDK (#12318 - @yahya-mouman)
* :sparkles: Add agent_version tag with subtree propagation to LLM Observability spans (#12291 - @ncybul)
* :sparkles: Add head-based sampling for LLM Observability traces (#12277 - @ncybul)
* :sparkles: Add in LLM Observability Prompt Tracking API (#12161 - @sabrenner)
* :sparkles: Add Support for Annotating Embedding and Retrieval Documents (#12149 - @sabrenner)
* :bug: Aggregate span.finished telemetry counts per interval (#12136 - @Yun-Kim)
* :sparkles: Add LLMObs.submitFeedback for end-user feedback submission (#12129 - @ddog-thibault-nadin)
* :sparkles: Add in LLM Observability Span Processor API (#12112 - @sabrenner)

## Metrics

* :bug: Fix OTLP trace-metrics attribute compliance gaps (#12144 - @mabdinur)
* :sparkles: Report stats span collapses over telemetry (client-side stats) (#12070 - @dougqh)

## OpenFeature

* :bug::sparkles: Support arbitrary semver parts (#12286 - @greghuels)
* :bug: Fix span enrichment singleton initialization (#12273 - @sameerank)
* :sparkles: Add direct flagevaluation fallback (#12204 - @leoromanovsky)
* :sparkles: Send agentless Feature Flags exposures directly to EVP (#12195 - @leoromanovsky)
* :sparkles: Add semantic version operators for feature flag evaluation (#12182 - @greghuels)
* :sparkles: Emit server-side EVP flagevaluation (#11639 - @leoromanovsky)
* :bug: Handle gracefully malformed flag evaluations; migrate Date->Instant (#11535 - @leoromanovsky)

## Profiling

* :bug: Bump ddprof to 1.50.0 (#12337 - @jbachorik)
* :broom: Revert carrier-scoped ddprof context storage export (#11826) (#12302 - @rkennke)
* :sparkles: Add support for native_socket ddprof config (#12175 - @kaahos)
* :bug: Bump java-profiler (ddprof) to 1.49.0 (#12168 - @jbachorik)

## Telemetry

* :sparkles: Add API Security schema extraction and missing-route metrics (#12300 - @jandro996)
* :bug: Aggregate span.finished telemetry counts per interval (#12136 - @Yun-Kim)
* :bug: Guard core-metric telemetry drain against queue-full delta loss (#12081 - @dougqh)
* :sparkles: Redact OTLP header and Datadog key configs in telemetry (#11583 - @bm1549)

## Trace context propagation

* :bug: Fix sfn x-datadog-tags input (#12320 - @ojproductions)
* :bug: Adding baggage limits for OT Baggage (#12303 - @mhlidd)

## Tracer core

* :bug: Preserve deterministic sampler rates (#12382 - @MilanGarnier)
* :sparkles: Support using GlobalObjectStore for non-field-injected contexts (#12381 - @mcculls)
* :bug: Fix span link span ID hex padding (#12279 - @itsamenathan - thanks for the contribution!)
* :bug: Only warn about trace buffer overflow when a kept trace is lost (#12348 - @dougqh)
* :sparkles: Update dd-instrument-java to v0.0.5 (#12344 - @mcculls)
* :sparkles: Update byte-buddy dependency to 1.18.12 (#12325 - @sarahchen6)
* :bulb: Allow tracer clock to be resynced after an AWS Lambda SnapStart restore (#11882 - @sheldon-nadarajah-sft - thanks for the contribution!)
* :sparkles: Add agent attribution to Java SDK (#12238 - @yahya-mouman)
* :bug: Fix uncaught StackOverflowError in StackTraces.getStackTrace (#12233 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Fix trailing element separator rejecting valid dd tracestate (#12229 - @mcculls)
* :zap::broom: Recalibrate the UTF8 caches every N spans instead of per span (#11945 - @dougqh)
* :broom: Wire mergedTracerTags as a read-through parent at span build (level-split) (phase 1a) (#11932 - @dougqh)

## Tracer internal logging

* :bug: Only warn about trace buffer overflow when a kept trace is lost (#12348 - @dougqh)

# Instrumentations

## Apache Spark instrumentation

* :bug: Route OpenLineage over the Agent's Unix Domain Socket URL (#12408 - @pawel-big-lebowski)

## AWS SDK instrumentation

* :bug: Fix sfn x-datadog-tags input (#12320 - @ojproductions)
* :bug: Fix SQS queue name tags from QueueUrl (#12159 - @ygree)

## Core Java language instrumentation

* :bug: Prevent NPE in HttpClientDecorator.isAgentRequest for a null request (#12376 - @dougqh)
* :bug: Fix NullPointerException in OSGi BundleWiringHelper when bundle reference is stale (#12241 - @dougqh)

## Guidewire instrumentation

* :bulb: Propagate trace context across Guidewire WSI SOAP worker threads (#12125 - @ValentinZakharov)

## Kafka instrumentation

* :sparkles: Capture Kafka consumer group membership on join (#11989 - @piochelepiotr)

## Netty instrumentation

* :bug: Treat Netty native client aborts as non-error responses (#12295 - @ygree)

## OpenTelemetry instrumentation

* :bug: Fix concurrent span event recording in OTel shim (#12053 - @Meemaw - thanks for the contribution!)
